# procedure step type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:procedureStepType`](gmeow-procedureStepType.md)

The kind(s) of a procedure step, drawn from the open [`gmeow:StepType`](../classes/gmeow-StepType.md) value vocabulary. Non-functional: a step may serve several purposes, and competing standpoint-indexed type claims coexist.
